name: PIONEER 11
missionStatus: Mission complete. Silent since 1995; leaving the solar system.
arrivalDate: Jupiter flyby: December 1974 · Saturn flyby: September 1979

model.note: Simplified visual reconstruction built in-app. Not an official NASA model.

briefNotes.text: Pioneer 11 flew past Jupiter and then became the first spacecraft to fly past Saturn. It is a separate mission from Pioneer 10 and carries its own Pioneer Plaque.
briefNotes.origin: Team research brief (NASA-based); final check against NASA sources recommended
